[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Reese''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] serving with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During a four-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] battle against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, he commanded a sector of the front line.
